name: midicaps_benchmark
description: A benchmark that pairs symbolic/score-based MIDI inputs with textual captions or tasks to evaluate models' ability to understand and generate musical descriptions or transformations. It measures how well models can map between musical (MIDI) representations and natural language, supporting tasks like captioning, retrieval, or conditional generation.
reputation: A small, domain-specific benchmark attracting interest from the music-ML community but not yet widely adopted outside that niche.
